subject: English
question_text: Look at the pie-chart below. It shows the amount of time
stimulus: that Rafique spends each day on various activities. Now, describe the pic-chart in your own words in 150 words.
guide_solution: Graph & charts The graph shows the elderly people's changing attitude to pastimes in a community. Here we see that in 1990, 32% of elderly people spent time watching TV which was 41% in 2000 and 49% in 2010. In case of playing cards the percentage was 34% in 1990, 36% in 2000 and 39% in 2010. On the other hand, the percentage of elderly people's time spending on drawing room chat was 17% in 1990, 12% in 2000 and 6% in 2010. Moreover, in 1990, people spent 17% of their time in other activities 11% in 2000 and 7% in 2010. Thus we see that the attitude to pastimes of the elderly people is changing. For example the tendency of watching television and playing cards is increasing while drawing room chats and others are decreasing.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 141 — Collectorate School, Rangpur
